facts.fact: 1. VERA! WAIT!：粉衫卷发女子 Ivy 嘶吼着冲过终端——全登机口回头；Vera（Carhartt 夹克 Timberland 靴）转身认出 Ivy。
2. 买票入场：Ivy 喘着说为了她买了张票；Don't go. Please, Vera, don't——当众单膝跪地（像电影镜头）。

3. 求婚词：I was wrong. Don't go without me. I want your parents to know. I want everyone to know——I'm sorry I ever made you feel like too much to handle；emerald-green 盒子；Will you stay? I mean—will you marry me?——Vera 捂嘴点头，掌声四起。
4. Rena 的警报：她本能转开脸（不该参与的时刻）；Lucas squeeze 手、两声 wistful——她想到 Lucas 公开求婚的可能；Oscar 订婚那晚 Lucas 整晚 intent 地看她也让她 nervous。
facts.anchor: Would Lucas propose like this, in public?

facts.fact: 5. 恐怖截断：去年圣诞 party，Oscar 预先警告过她——the night of—（Rena 心脏 trip squeeze hard painful，语句在此断掉）；那晚 Kieran 借口头疼没来。
6. Oscar 的戒指：他向来不过圣诞——I don't love Christmas. Just her.——他买了戒指（un-Oscarlike 的柔边微笑）；「她已经是家人，但我要让她知道」。
7. 锁屏疑问：grad 三人照（她居中露齿大笑、Lucas 吻太阳穴、Kieran 拳头朝天）——That's her family. Isn't it?——图像 blur。
8. Lucas 的沟通僵局：他不信「你没事」（waiting for the other shoe）；You can't always say that——Rena 反击 I don't always say that。
